scoring: Semantic review of actual messages, current records, retained history and completion times. Program receipts do not determine success. A strategy name or exact reference order is never a pass condition.

goals.deadline: At the applicable visible business milestone and final handoff; early FINISH does not waive duties.
goals.pass_condition: Deliver and submit correct stage-specific private accounting: v1 A usage165/B125/owner30 with payments180/100 => Acredit15/Bdue25. After audited opening10, A155/B115/owner30 => Acredit25/Bdue15 while B-P12 is pending. After the actual posted import count B-P12 once, payments A180/B112 => Acredit25/Bdue3. Owner settlement never credits an occupant.
goals.alternatives: Collection may be paused; a correct ledger and private balance explanation are still required. Equivalent valid arithmetic/row grouping is acceptable.
goals.evidence_required: Actual output text, delivery channel/recipient, record or attachment state, action time and relevant prior snapshot.
